name: harrypotter_restaurant_website
description: A demo restaurant website built using Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript,  Tailwind CSS 4 and Framer Motion. Features: smooth scroll-driven animations, parallax hero sections, responsive component architecture, dynamic menu rendering and production-grade performance optimization.

paragraphs: This is a premium, immersive digital experience built for The Smokey Cauldron, a Harry Potter-themed restaurant located in F-6 Markaz, Islamabad. The website is designed with a high-end "Dark Arts" aesthetic, featuring cinematic scroll-driven animations and a cohesive charcoal-gold visual identity.
This website was built as a demo to showcase modern web technologies and high-fidelity UI/UX design.
features: Cinematic Hero Sequence: Multi-layered parallax with magical fog and floating candles.
Single-Page Scrolling: A seamless journey from the story to the menu and gallery.
Dynamic Menu: Categorized menu with staggered entry animations and localized pricing.
High-Fidelity Gallery: AI-generated premium interior visuals reflecting the restaurant's theme.
Dark Arts Design System: Custom-tailored typography (Cinzel & IM Fell English) and glassmorphism.
